title: Anna A. Hancock Mrs. Proprietress Of Luebberts Pharmacy, 169 Nanking Road

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL
S. B. REC
D.

MEMORANDUM ON MRS. W.L. STANLEY (NEE REIDER).

Eugenie Alice Stanley nee Reider is a Russian Jewess born on June 29, 1896 at Kiev, South Russia. She is the daughter of Abram Itskovitch Reider, native of Herson, South Russia, a merchant by occupation. It is reported that he resided in Harbin until 1925 when he came to Shanghai. For the past few years he has been residing together with his wife at Tsingtao where he works as a salesman on commission basis. It is rumoured that he was formerly engaged in the smuggling of narcotics.

The Reider family are relatives of I. Soolevitch, Soviet citizen, who came to the notice of the Municipal Police as the proprietor of boarding-houses which he conducted at various addresses in the Settlement from 1924 to 1932 and which were patronized almost exclusively by Soviet agents and employees of local Soviet concerns. Morris I. Soolevitch, his son, was employed with the Shanghai branch of the Chinese Eastern Railway from 1926 till 1930, following which he established the "Union Steamship Agency", No. 51 Canton Road. He maintains close business relations with local Soviet commercial institutions. He is suspected of being a Soviet intelligence agent. Mrs. Olga Rosenbloom, the daughter of I. Soolevitch, has a somewhat doubtful reputation and is known to be connected with certain shady characters locally.

While in her 'teens Eugenie A. Reider was sent by her parents from Harbin to Shanghai where she entered the Public School for Girls. It is reported that she was expelled from that institution at the age of about 16 years for immoral conduct. Some time later she married a French merchant residing at Tientsin, Raymond Marcel Tantot. On January 14, 1924 she obtained a divorce by decree of the French Consular Court at Tientsin, following which she

关于 W.L. 斯坦利夫人（娘家姓赖德）的备忘录。

尤金妮·爱丽丝·斯坦利（Eugenie Alice Stanley），娘家姓赖德（Reider），是一名俄罗斯犹太女性，1896年6月29日出生于南俄基辅。她是阿布拉姆·伊茨科维奇·赖德（Abram Itskovitch Reider）的女儿，其父系南俄赫尔松人，职业为商人。据报，他居住在哈尔滨直至1925年，随后来到上海。过去几年，他与妻子一同居住在青岛，在那里担任佣金制推销员。有谣言称他从前从事毒品走私活动。

赖德家族是苏联公民 I. 苏列维奇（I. Soolevitch）的亲戚。此人因在1924年至1932年间于租界内多处地址经营寄宿公寓而进入工部局警务处的视线，这些公寓几乎 exclusively 由苏联特工和当地苏联机构的雇员光顾。莫里斯·I·苏列维奇（Morris I. Soolevitch）是其子，1926年至1930年间受雇于中东铁路上海办事处，此后他在广东路51号成立了“联合轮船代理行”（Union Steamship Agency）。他与当地苏联商业机构保持着密切的业务关系。他被怀疑是苏联情报特工。奥尔加·罗森布鲁姆夫人（Mrs. Olga Rosenbloom）是 I. 苏列维奇的女儿，声誉颇受质疑，已知与当地某些 shady characters（原文不清/含义不明，暂译：可疑人物）有牵连。

尤金妮·A·赖德在青少年时期被父母从哈尔滨送往上海，进入女子公立学校就读。据报，她约16岁时因行为不端被该机构开除。不久后，她嫁给了一位居住在天津的法国商人雷蒙德·马塞尔·坦托（Raymond Marcel Tantot）。1924年1月14日，她通过天津法国领事法院的判决获得离婚，随后她

page_data.en:
- Page 2 -

resumed her maiden name J.A. Reider (or G. Reyder or G.M.
Ryder).

She reappeared in Shanghai in 1926 and from 1927
till 1931 conducted a boarding-house first at No.720 Avenue
Joffre and later at No.31 Carter Road. In 1931 she opened
a Ladies' Dressmaking Shop under the name "Piccadilly",
No.127-A Seymour Road, which she sold in 1932 to Mrs. A.
Hancock owing to bad business. During that period she
bought on credit various materials from the Femina Silk
Store, No.1017 Bubbling Well Road, owned by one Zalmanoff,
for the sum of M.$217.72. In payment of her debt she issued
a worthless cheque dated November 20, 1930 on the Shanghai
Commercial & Savings Bank, No.50 Ningpo Road, and for the
rest of the sum signed eight chits, which she also failed
to meet. In connection with this matter Zalmanoff brought
a civil suit against Reider at the Shanghai Special District
Court. On 14.5.32 judgment was given for the plaintiff,
who later applied for and in October 1932 obtained execution
order from the same court. On November 10, 1932 Zalmanoff
accompanied by the French Police visited the Mei Tsei Silk
Shop, No.10 Avenue Dubail, where Mrs. Reider was employed
at that time. She could not be found and it was later
ascertained that she was a French citizen and therefore
not amenable to Chinese jurisdiction. The complainant then
dropped the case. It appears that Reider still has many
further outstanding debts.

It is reported that in 1930 Mrs. Reider became the
paramour of W.L. Stanley, who at that time was employed as
a probationary sergeant in the S.M.P. and to whom she was
eventually married on December 13/21, 1932 at the local
British Consulate-General. Shortly before his marriage
Stanley won $3,000 in a lottery and it would appear that
this was the big attraction to the woman. On December 9,
page_data.zh:
- 第 2 页 -

恢复了未婚时的姓氏 J.A. 赖德（或 G. Reyder 或 G.M. Ryder）。

她于1926年再次出现在上海，并从1927年至1931年经营一家寄宿公寓，起初位于霞飞路720号，后来迁至卡特路31号。1931年，她在西摩路127-A号以“皮卡迪利”（Piccadilly）为名开设了一家女装裁缝店，后因生意不佳于1932年卖给 A. 汉考克夫人。在此期间，她从静安寺路1017号由扎尔马诺夫（Zalmanoff）所有的 Femina 丝绸店赊购了价值规元217.72元的各种材料。为了偿还债务，她开具了一张日期为1930年11月20日、付款行为宁波路50号上海商业储蓄银行的空头支票，并就剩余款项签署了八张借据，但这些借据也未能兑现。就此事宜，扎尔马诺夫在上海特区地方法院对赖德提起民事诉讼。1932年5月14日，法院作出有利于原告的判决，原告随后提出申请，并于1932年10月从同一法院获得执行令。1932年11月10日，扎尔马诺夫在法国警察的陪同下前往杜拜尔路10号的梅兹丝绸店（Mei Tsei Silk Shop），赖德夫人当时受雇于此。未能找到她，后查明她是法国公民，因此不受中国司法管辖。投诉人随后撤回了案件。看来赖德仍有许多其他未偿债务。

据报，1930年赖德夫人成为 W.L. 斯坦利的情妇，斯坦利当时在工部局警务处担任试用警长，两人最终于1932年12月13/21日在当地英国总领事馆结婚。就在结婚前不久，斯坦利在彩票中赢得了3,000美元，这似乎是对该女子的巨大吸引力。12月9日，

page_data.en:
- Page 3 -
1932 Stanley ~~resigned~~ dismissed from the Police and through the medium
of his wife obtained employment with the Union Steamship
Agency, No.51 Canton Road, owned by Morris Soolevitch, Mrs.
Stanley's cousin.
On January 6, 1933 Mrs. Stanley applied for a British
passport at the local British Consulate-General. In the
application form she stated that she had been born on June 29,
1903 at Amiens, France.
In February 1933 Mrs. Stanley borrowed $700.00 from
the Shanghai Finance Company, No.38 Avenue Edward VII, her
husband and Morris Soolevitch acting as guarantors. She
failed to pay back this money in due time with the result
that Soolevitch paid $300 representing that part of the loan
for which he had guaranteed. For the remainder $400 Mr.
Paul Premet, owner of the Shanghai Finance Company, sued
Mrs. Stanley in the British Court.
Since March, 1933 the Stanleys have been residing
at No.52 Verdun Terrace. When signing the agreement for
these premises Stanley gave his place of employment as the
Union Steamship Agency. The rent is usually paid 2-3 months
in arrears. Stanley was re-engaged by the Municipal Police
on December 13, 1933. Recently, on seeing in the Municipal
Gazette that Stanley, on September 19, 1934, had been dismissed
from the force for gross misconduct and serious breach of
discipline, Algar & Co., agents for No.52 Verdun Terrace,
sent a letter to him requesting payment of 3 months' rental
in arrears. The following day Mrs. Stanley called at the
office of Algar & Co. and in a very excited manner informed
them that they might set their mind at rest as regards the
payment of the rental because her husband had already
obtained employment with the Union Steamship Agency.
Enquiries at Algar & Co. show inter alia that several
page_data.zh:
- 第 3 页 -
1932年，斯坦利 ~~辞职~~ 被警方开除，并通过其妻子的关系，在莫里斯·苏列维奇拥有的联合轮船代理行（广东路51号）找到了工作，莫里斯·苏列维奇是斯坦利夫人的表亲。
1933年1月6日，斯坦利夫人向当地英国总领事馆申请英国护照。在申请表中，她声称自己于1903年6月29日出生于法国亚眠。
1933年2月，斯坦利夫人从爱多亚路38号的上海金融公司借款700.00美元，由其丈夫和莫里斯·苏列维奇担任担保人。她未能按时偿还这笔钱，导致苏列维奇支付了300美元，即他所担保的那部分贷款。对于剩余的400美元，上海金融公司的所有者保罗·普雷梅特（Paul Premet）先生在英皇法庭起诉了斯坦利夫人。
自1933年3月以来，斯坦利夫妇一直居住在凡尔登台52号。在签署该房屋的协议时，斯坦利将其工作地点列为联合轮船代理行。租金通常拖欠2-3个月。斯坦利于1933年12月13日被工部局警务处重新录用。最近，当在《工部局公报》上看到斯坦利因严重行为不端和严重违反纪律于1934年9月19日被开除出警队时，凡尔登台52号的代理人阿尔加公司（Algar & Co.）给他发了一封信，要求支付拖欠的3个月租金。第二天，斯坦利夫人来到阿尔加公司办公室，非常激动地告诉他们，关于租金支付的问题可以放心，因为她的丈夫已经在联合轮船代理行找到了工作。
向阿尔加公司查询显示，除其他事项外，该公司收到几起

page_data.en:
- Page 4 -

complaints have been received by the company from the Stanleys
neighbours against Mrs. Stanley who is said to be a very
insolent and arrogant individual.

Mrs. Stanley is reported to be very friendly with
Mrs. O. Rosenbloom and with an American named Leonie C.
Thibau, who resides at Rosenbloom's house, No.24 Verdun
Terrace.

In connection with Mrs. Stanley's application for
passport facilities, the following points are more than
significant, indicating that she made certain false statements
in order to obtain the passport.

1. She states that she was born at Amiens, whereas it is
definitely known that her birth place was Kiev, South
Russia.

2. Her date of birth she gives as 29.6.1903 whilst at the
local French Consulate-General where she was formerly
registered, she declared that she was born on 29.6.1896.
In addition, information shows that she is over 40 years
old.

3. She declared on her application for marriage that her
father's name was Alex, but our enquiries show that this
is not correct, his proper name being Abraham.

She holds British Passport No.9521 dated 9.1.33.
page_data.zh:
- 第 4 页 -

来自斯坦利邻居的针对斯坦利夫人的投诉，据说她是一个非常无礼和傲慢的人。

据报，斯坦利夫人与 O. 罗森布鲁姆夫人以及一位名叫莱奥妮·C·蒂博（Leonie C. Thibau）的美国人名关系非常友好，后者居住在罗森布鲁姆家中，地址为凡尔登台24号。

关于斯坦利夫人申请护照一事，以下几点尤为值得注意，表明她为了获得护照做出了某些虚假陈述。

1. 她声称出生于亚眠，而确凿已知她的出生地是南俄基辅。

2. 她给出的出生日期是1903年6月29日，而在她以前注册过的当地法国总领事馆，她申报的出生日期是1896年6月29日。此外，信息显示她已超过40岁。

3. 她在结婚申请中声明其父亲的名字是亚历克斯（Alex），但我们的调查显示这不正确，其真名是亚伯拉罕（Abraham）。

她持有1933年1月9日签发的英国护照，号码为9521。

page_data.en:
Mrs W.L.Stanley (nee Raider)

In 1931 Mrs W.L.Stanley acting obviously on request of her relative M.I.Soulevich
attempted to obtain confidential information from S.M.P Special Branch Files re Soviet
activity etc through her husband W.L.Stanley, British at that time employed with S.M.P
Headquarters. It was discovered and Stanley was dismissed from S.M.P on December 8, 1932
and through the medium of his wife obtained employment with the Union Steamship Agency
No 51 Canton Road, owned by Morris I.Soulevich her relative. a well known Soviet Agent.
page_data.zh:
W.L. 斯坦利夫人（娘家姓赖德）

1931年，W.L. 斯坦利夫人显然应其亲戚 M.I. 苏列维奇的要求，试图通过其丈夫 W.L. 斯坦利从工部局警务处特别部档案中获取有关苏联活动等机密信息，斯坦利当时是英国籍，受雇于工部局警务处总部。此事被发现，斯坦利于1932年12月8日被工部局警务处开除，并通过其妻子的关系，在她亲戚、著名的苏联特工莫里斯·I·苏列维奇拥有的联合轮船代理行（广东路51号）找到了工作。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No............
S.I, Special Branch. **〔此处转录不清〕**
REPORT
Date June 30, 19 38.

Subject Anne A. Hancock (Mrs.), proprietress of Luebbert's Pharmacy,
169 Nanking Road.

Made by D.S. Hide ................................ Forwarded by ................................

Enquiries reveal that in 1921 Mrs. Anna Hancock was the
proprietress of a bookstore in Vladivostok at which time she
was known as Mrs. A.A. Potopoff being the widow of a Russian
Infantry officer.

She arrived in Shanghai in 1923 and in 1924 was married
to ex-Sub-Inspector Hancock of the Shanghai Municipal Police,
who resigned on November 28th, 1937 and proceeded to Australia.

In 1932 Mrs. Hancock purchased the Picadilly Dressmaking
Salon from Mrs. W.L. Stanley, wife of ex-sergeant Stanley of
the Shanghai Municipal Police. She later disposed of this
concern and in 1937 went on a trip to England and America
from where she returned to Shanghai on May 14th, 1938.
Shortly afterwards she purchased the concern known as Luebbert's
Pharmacy at 169 Nanking Road.

Sergeant P.B. Potapoff who joined the Shanghai Municipal
Police on November 22nd, 1929 is Mrs. Hancock's son by her
first marriage. He has tendered his resignation to take
effect from July 20th 1938 and it is understood that he has
an interest in Luebbert's Pharmacy.

Apart from her association with ex-Sub-Inspector Hancock,
Mrs. Hancock has not come to the notice of the Police and nothing
further is known regarding her.

One of the two assistants at present employed at Luebbert's
Pharmacy, is a Russian named O.G. Shasolin of 1160 Bubbling
Well Road. Owing to the short notice at which this report has
been made nothing is at present known regarding the other
assistants.

So far as can be ascertained none of the above persons have
any pharmaceutical qualifications.

D.C. (Special Branch)                                **〔签名：Hide〕**
                                                       D.S.

上海公共租界警务处。    档案号 ____ 
S.I, 特别部。 **〔此处转录不清〕**
报告
日期 1938年6月30日。

主题：安妮·A·汉考克夫人（Mrs. Anne A. Hancock），南京路169号吕伯特药房（Luebbert's Pharmacy）业主。

制作人：D.S. Hide  ____  转呈人： ____ 

调查显示，1921年安娜·汉考克夫人是符拉迪沃斯托克一家书店的业主，当时她被称为 A.A. 波托波夫夫人（Mrs. A.A. Potopoff），是一位俄罗斯步兵军官的遗孀。

她于1923年抵达上海，并于1924年嫁给上海公共租界工部局警务处的前副督察汉考克（ex-Sub-Inspector Hancock），后者于1937年11月28日辞职并前往澳大利亚。

1932年，汉考克夫人从上海公共租界工部局警务处前警长斯坦利的妻子 W.L. 斯坦利夫人手中购买了皮卡迪利女装裁缝沙龙。她后来处置了这项产业，并于1937年前往英国和美国旅行，于1938年5月14日从那里返回上海。不久之后，她购买了位于南京路169号的名为吕伯特药房的产业。

P.B. 波塔波夫警长（Sergeant P.B. Potapoff）于1929年11月22日加入上海公共租界工部局警务处，是汉考克夫人第一次婚姻所生的儿子。他已提出辞呈，自1938年7月20日起生效，据悉他在吕伯特药房拥有权益。

除了与前副督察汉考克的关系外，汉考克夫人并未引起警方的注意，关于她没有更多已知情况。

目前在吕伯特药房雇佣的两名助理之一，是一位名叫 O.G. Shasolin 的俄罗斯人，住址为静安寺路1160号。由于本报告制作时间仓促，目前对其他助理一无所知。

据查，上述人员均无任何药学资格。

特别部副主任                                **〔签名：Hide〕**
                                                       D.S.

调查显示，1921年安娜·汉考克夫人是符拉迪沃斯托克一家书店的业主，当时她被称为 A.A. 波托波夫夫人（Mrs. A.A. Potopoff），是一位俄罗斯步兵军官的遗孀。

她于1923年抵达上海，并于1924年嫁给上海公共租界工部局警务处的前副督察汉考克，后者于1937年11月28日辞职并前往澳大利亚。

1932年，汉考克夫人从上海公共租界工部局警务处前警长斯坦利的妻子 W.L. 斯坦利夫人手中购买了皮卡迪利女装裁缝沙龙。她后来处置了这项产业，并于1937年前往英国和美国旅行，于1938年5月14日从那里返回上海。不久之后，她购买了位于南京路169号的名为吕伯特药房的产业。

P.B. 波塔波夫警长于1929年11月22日加入上海公共租界工部局警务处，是汉考克夫人第一次婚姻所生的儿子。他已提出辞呈，自1938年7月20日起生效，据悉他在吕伯特药房拥有权益。

（印：日常生活 / 1938年6月 / （犯罪科））

除了与前副督察汉考克的关系外，汉考克并未引起警方的注意，关于她没有更多已知情况。

目前在吕伯特药房雇佣的两名助理之一，是一位名叫 O.G. Shasolin 的俄罗斯人，住址为静安寺路1160号。由于本报告制作时间仓促，目前对其他助理一无所知。

据查，上述人员均无任何药学资格。

（批注：Jore / 38 / 6 / 25 / Auger）
